page.overview:
Who is Cardiodon?

(meaning "heart tooth") is an extinct genus of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/sauropod sauropod] dinosaur from the Middle Jurassic period in England. It was the first sauropod to be ever named, specifically by Richard Owen in 1841. Being very obscure, it is usually referred to as a species or a potential synonym of Cetiosaurus. However, recent studies show that this dinosaur is a different genus and is possibly related to Turiasaurus.

Cardiodon is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. The artwork is a flipped and recolored Kotasaurus.
